newsitem.title: USA: Axsys says Gildea holds 5 pct stake.
newsitem.headline: Axsys says Gildea holds 5 pct stake.

text.p: Axsys Technologies Inc said on Wednesday that it had learned that the chief executive officer of Gildea Management Co, John Gildea, and a related entity, owned 154,500 shares of Axsys common stock.
Axsys learned of the stock acquisition through a Securities and Exchange Commission Schedule 13D filing.

Axsys said the filing persons acquired their shares at prices between $11.92 and $12.38 per share. The company also said they stated in the filing that they currently intend to hold the shares for investment.

Axsys designs and manufactures optical and positioning components and subsystems for high-performance markets such as commercial satellites, defense digital imaging and semiconductor capital equipment.
